label: V0_21_butter_clean
notes: Cycle-6 experiment: V0_16 recipe (h=128, flat TV=20, seed=1) on butter-concordant training data (128,466 rows after dropping 11.27% ssim2/butter rank-discordant pairs). Single-bake trade-off: CID22=0.8874 (-0.0045 vs V0_16; below ssim2), AIC-3=0.8060 (+0.0070 vs V0_16; clearly above ssim2 by +0.0095). Non-mono=2.91%. NOT shipped as single bake. BUT — in 5-bake ensemble (V0_16/V0_18/V0_19/V0_20/V0_21), V0_21's complementary signal lifts ensemble to CID22 0.8896 (+0.0001 vs ssim2) AND AIC-3 0.8012 (+0.0047). The recipe-best.
